entries.notes: R21 (c-0004 r21-int-bok-b18, executor builder-r20s1; claim filed BEFORE any call; verifier record pending from the peer per Art. 29(c)). Round 1/2 of the Art. 20 clock: the arm does NOT beat the single-draw incumbent on the changed-arm metric (intervention feasibility |gap| 2.0 vs 1.5; novelty 2.278 vs 2.333 — the incumbent also wins novelty). TYPED LESSON: the judge-blind selector carried no feasibility signal — critic/procurement/grounding compliance does not correlate with the judged axis, and the selector's bill-heavy preference plausibly reads as burden (2 pairs went novelty-NEGATIVE: eval-new01 nd=-2, eval-new05 nd=-2 — conventionalized selections). Round 2 contingency (pre-registered decision, this round's typed finding is its basis): a revised selector must carry a feasibility-correlated signal or the arm is RETIRED at rounds_without_beating=2 (the CI enforces the clock). The transport-robustness lever (peer c-0002) is VALIDATED and rides the incumbent bytes unchanged.

entries.notes: AM24 D1 = ROUND 2/2 of this arm (claim c-0014, work_id r24-v61-constraint-bind, executor builder-r20s1; pre-registration pushed BEFORE any LLM call). The lever is UNCHANGED in kind (contract-level bind at mechanism choice — no clock reset, Art. 20 anti-zombie); round 2 strengthens it with the F36 constraint-awareness fix the auditor demanded: the contract reads the problem's OWN constraint text (allowed-measures enumerations = hard lists; exclusion cues = hard exclusions; performance bounds = bill verification targets) and the machine repair loop carries a typed deterministic constraint-fit scan (scripts/r24_constraint_scan.py, findings disclosed). Round-1 evidence motivating round 2: the bind fixed the V5 failure modes (repairs 29->19, residuals 11->5) and produced 2/18 PERFECT-parity rows (fgap=0 with nd=4), but a heavy tail (7/18 at fgap=4) dominated the mean; the F36 evidence (HO2-03 zinc-anode collar and HO2-04 intake-humidity OUTSIDE the stated allowed measures) shows the machine reaches for out-of-scope measures — the round-2 bind targets exactly that. Round-2 rule: if not beating the incumbent on the primary metric, the contract-bind lever RETIRES at 2 (no round 3 under this lever kind).
